hint: tap anywhere to paint the porch

game.q: young zeno was shy. his teacher crates cured it. how?
opts: made him give a speech in the market
made him carry soup through town
booked him a slot at open mic night

wrong.speech: too obvious for crates. he went weirder.

game.right: YES. a pot of lentil soup. then crates smashed it with his staff: nothing terrible has happened to you.

end.line: a shipwrecked merchant taught on a public porch, and the porch gave the stoics their name.
end.l2: a porch named a whole school.

cliff.s1: a boxer hauls water all night
cliff.s2: so he can study all day. then he’s called before the court.

share: two ears. one mouth. do the math. zeno’s painted porch on infinite hill
